level_differences.holm_note: Holm across every (signal, level-pair) comparison in this block; per-level intervals cannot test levels against each other because the levels are nested subsets of the same samples
level_differences.test: paired stratified bootstrap on the AUROC difference

ablation.note: the first N of the same five samples are reused at every level, so the differences between levels are due to sample count and not to drawing a different sample set

A.note: logprobs come back with the greedy answer, so family A is free

B.note: 5 sampled generations plus one NLI clustering pass over the sample set

C.note: one extra scoring pass for P(True) or one short generation

T.note: computed from text already in hand

cost.method: extra-model-call multiples; a verification scoring pass counts as one call regardless of prompt length, so this is not a token price
cost.token_unit: multiple of mean greedy total tokens; family C is null because verification prompts are not tokenized in the artifacts
cost.unit: multiple of the single greedy answer every signal requires

gold_leakage.method: normalized gold alias as contiguous token subsequence of the question

family_b_clustering.note: rows where greedy single-pass assignment and transitive-closure clustering partition the answer set differently; on disagreement the exhaustive partition is primary

primary.note: every signal is scored on this exact row set; per-signal gaps are recorded as missing_n rather than by dropping rows

with_abstentions.note: every signal is scored on this exact row set; per-signal gaps are recorded as missing_n rather than by dropping rows
